entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Talk about a gruesome accident...[n]Eighty people were involved.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here's a diary. Make sure you keep it[n]up to date.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You may be under probation, but there's[n]no special limitations on what you do[n]in particular.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Besides following the law, that is.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: However, I'm obligated to report on you,[n]which is why I'm having you record your[n]daily activities.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't worry. I'll be there in no time.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, I'm off. I'll lock the place up, so[n]do whatever you want for the rest of[n]the night.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, but don't mess up my store.[n]If something goes missing, I'll hand[n]you right over to the cops.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You got school tomorrow... You better[n]head off to bed, all right?
I should do as I'm told for now...
